adversarial pass on lint_ban_prose.py, dispatched WITHOUT the brief and told to reproduce every objection by executing the module rather than asserting it. 11 objections, 8 of which broke the first version: prose split across two lines; a bare mapping value; suffixes the workflow triggers on but the lint did not read; an attribute docstring ast.get_docstring cannot see; a homoglyph; a backslash-escaped apostrophe the quote scanner misread (checked against bash itself); the vendor name smuggled INSIDE the placeholder hole; and the step being a documented no-op on every push to main, which falsified the control's own threat model. Plus 2 SHOULD-FIX on the anti-bypass failing open in silence and a deletion-only PR reading as a blind scan, and 4 verified over-matches on ordinary engineering prose. The seat also reported 4 attacks that FAILED, including a rename-and-launder against a real throwaway repo. All 11 addressed or pinned as a documented limit; the over-match fix removed 5 of the 16 files the first pardon list had frozen, which were false positives.

re-attacked the rewrite. Four fixes re-verified as genuine. Three were PARTIAL: a value captured to the first whitespace let a null first token stand in for everything after the space; the adjacent-line join covered pairs only, so one more newline walked past it; and the bare mapping predicate both missed a real credential and condemned a real sentence. One NEW blocking over-match in the C-family scanner added for round 1 — a block comment ran to end of line instead of to its terminator, condemning the CODE beside a short comment, and a double slash inside a string was read as a comment. Plus a real corpus gap: every test of the anti-bypass either stubbed the function out or hit a ref where the file was absent, so a set-difference replaced by a length check would have passed everything. The seat also corrected the conductor's premise about base.sha by reading hotzone_changed_files.sh, and declared two attacks that FAILED. All addressed; the unquoted bare mapping form is now a stated limit rather than a heuristic.
